narrative.overview: The site presents healthcare data and AI consulting as routed operational signals: questions, sources, governance controls, build paths, and business outcomes. The first viewport shows this mechanism directly through a dark signal board, not through generic consulting imagery. The system should feel senior, specific, and commercial. It borrows discipline from traffic-control diagrams and data lineage maps, then keeps the reading surface calm enough for healthcare executives.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, diagrammatic surfaces with strong borders.
Red, amber, and green status language tied to risk, governance, and readiness.
Public proof links plus anonymized private capability language.

rules.name: The No Default Healthcare Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue gradients do not belong on this site unless a future brand decision explicitly changes the palette.

rules.name: The Signal Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Red, amber, and green must describe risk, governance, readiness, or action. Do not use them as random decoration.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section headings do not use kicker labels. The heading must carry its own weight.

rules.name: The Flat Control Surface Rule
rules.body: Do not pair hairline borders with wide ambient shadows. Choose a rule or a state shadow, not both.

dos: Do sell paid diagnostics, build sprints, prototypes, and advisory work as explicit offers.
Do tie AI copy to data readiness, governance, workflow fit, and measurable business action.
Do distinguish public proof from anonymized private capability language.
Do keep section spacing generous and content blocks scan-friendly.
donts: Don't invent client logos, testimonials, prices, certifications, revenue outcomes, or employer endorsement.
Don't name private employer systems or private local repos as public case studies.
Don't use generic AI agency language, purple gradients, glassmorphism, or decorative icon cards.
Don't turn mono labels into long body copy.
